entities.name: Zele Lipovača

entities.summary: Sead "Zele" Lipovača is a Bosnian and Yugoslav rock musician, songwriter and music producer, currently based in Zagreb, Croatia, best known as the guitarist and leader of the popular hard rock and heavy metal band Divlje Jagode.
